meta.title: Worth it? The Most Expensive Levi 501 Jeans ($260)
meta.description:
Buy Levi LVC Jeans here! https://fave.co/40sNH2Q

I forget who asked BUT today we are reviewing the Levi 501XX 1947 LVC jeans! LVC stands for Levi's Vintage Clothing and the name is what it sounds like, Levi's vintage reproductions of their classic fits and clothes! They don't just do jeans BUT these are raw, unsanforized, and selvedge of course, they are NOT the STF model though...however they still are STF so I hope that's not confusing. LVC also does shirts, sweaters, socks(?) you name it. Cool stuff? Yup! But what about the quality? Are they worth it? Are they worthy? Find out!
